intro: Haiti has had no elected president or parliament since 2021 and is led by a transitional government.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: A transitional council governed until February 2026; since then the prime minister has led the country while elections are planned. Armed gangs control much of Port-au-Prince, and over a million people have been forced from their homes.

chapters.title: International help
text: A Kenyan-led security mission arrived in 2024. In 2025 the UN approved a larger Gang Suppression Force to replace it.
